research_rationale:
Identity: the registered original is the Federal Register text of Executive Order 13168 (65 FR 58217, PDF pages 1-2 of the 2000-09-27 issue; sha256 4fd3fdda...), headed Executive Order 13168 of September 22, 2000, President’s Commission on Improving Economic Opportunity in Communities Dependent on Tobacco Production While Protecting Public Health, matching the census register row (2000-09-22). Text and inventory: ten scopes cover sections 1 through 6 to the signature; I confirm the inventory. All clauses belong to one advisory commission. Ending: Executive Order 13225 section 3(d) revokes Executive Order 13168, effective September 30, 2001 (section 5), which is earlier than the outer limit of section 6 (September 22, 2002). The report deadlines in section 4 and the report-relative termination in section 6 are not ends (owner ruling of 2026-10-21 on report deadlines). Original grade: Federal Register machine text.
